title: Asphyxial Deaths: Findings and Interpretation Limits
subject: Forensic Medicine
preview: Asphyxial deaths can arise through several mechanisms including airway obstruction, neck compression or impaired ventilation.
quickRevision: Asphyxial deaths can arise through several mechanisms including airway obstruction, neck compression or impaired ventilation.
Neck injuries, scene reconstruction and autopsy findings require careful correlation.
The manner of death cannot be inferred solely from a single external mark.

sections.title: Recognize the core pattern
points: Asphyxial deaths can arise through several mechanisms including airway obstruction, neck compression or impaired ventilation.
Petechial hemorrhages are nonspecific and may occur in circumstances other than asphyxia.

sections.title: Clinical examination and interpretation
points: Neck injuries, scene reconstruction and autopsy findings require careful correlation.
The manner of death cannot be inferred solely from a single external mark.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Absence of petechiae does not exclude an asphyxial mechanism.
